The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
 Meet Nuvei , Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We're dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
 Your Mission
 We are looking for a Senior Power BI Analyst to join our fast-growing Business Automation & Analytics team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and governing advanced Power BI solutions, with a key focus on delivering high-quality, data-driven insights to operational teams and senior management.
In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert in business intelligence, ensuring that reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, and aligned with organizational standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust analytical solutions, while promoting best practices in data modeling, visualization, and governance. The position requires a high level of professionalism, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of enterprise-level Power BI dashboards and reports
 Partner with business stakeholders, senior management, and C-level executives to define KPIs, metrics, and reporting requirements
Report insights, trends, and solution recommendations directly to C-level and senior leadership to support strategic decision-making
Translate complex business needs into scalable data models, advanced DAX calculations, and user-friendly visualizations
 Ensure data accuracy, consistency, governance, and ongoing data hygiene across all reporting and analytical assets
Drive data hygiene initiatives, including identifying data quality gaps, standardizing definitions, and improving source system reliability
Optimize performance of datasets, reports, and data refresh processes in alignment with best practices
Establish and enforce Power BI standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members
Deliver analytical insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making
 Requirements
6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics, with significant hands-on experience in Power BI
Advanced proficiency in DAX, data modeling, and Power Query
Strong experience with SQL, data warehousing, and ETL processes
Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and deliver business-focused analytical solutions
Deep understanding of business 
Strong communication skills in English (reading and speaking required)
 Benefits
 The benefits will be discussed with the TA Partner.

So, please come as you are. We can't wait to meet you.
